answer_1.quote: We consider retrieval-based QA systems, which are mainly constituted by (i) a search engine, retrieving top-k documents related to the questions, and (ii) an Answer Sentence Selection (AS2) model, which reranks passages/sentences extracted from the documents.
answer_1.outputs: The paper focuses on evaluating generated answer sentences in open-domain QA, where systems produce free-text answers to questions.

answer_2.quote: We study the performance of AVA in predicting: (i) the correctness of the individual answers output by a system (point-wise estimation); and (ii) the overall system performance derived on a test set.

answer_4.quote: top candidates for each question are manually assessed as correct or incorrect by human judges.
answer_4.guideline: The evaluation involves determining whether an answer candidate is correct or incorrect with respect to a question and a reference answer.
